# 1. Peasant Land & Tax Relief Charter (famine, Little Ice Age, or serfdom)
oe_cri2_rd_peasant_land_relief = {
	trigger = {
		rebel_category = estate
		rebel_estate_type = estate_type:peasants_estate
		owner = {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_peasant_relief }
			OR = {
				any_province = { is_starving = yes }
				has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age
				societal_value:serfdom_vs_free_subjects < 0
			}
		}
	}
	concession_effect = {
		pacify_rebel_pops = yes
		grant_benefits_to_estate = yes
		owner = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_cri2_charter_peasant_relief
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
			change_societal_value = {
				type = serfdom_vs_free_subjects
				value = societal_value_move_to_right
			}
		}
	}
}

# 4. Edict of Conscience & Religious Toleration (Age of Reformation+ reconciliation instead of forced conversion)
oe_cri2_rd_religious_toleration = {
	trigger = {
		rebel_category = religious
		owner = {
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_religious_toleration }

	}
}
